name: Media dye
doc: The picture is the dye in a stable-fluids tank (semi-Lagrangian advection, vorticity confinement, Jacobi pressure projection): four slow stirrers that the bass winds up swirl it, every onset kicks a splash outward from a seeded spot, its own contours (core-media's edges) push the flow along them and its bright areas rise; the live picture keeps seeping back in, bright parts first, and re-forms at the start of every phrase. Lit like wet ink, with the palette bleeding into the fast-running streaks.

in.doc: the picture, used as the dye (core-media.out)

luma.doc: brightness: where the picture resurfaces first and what rises (core-media.luma)

edges.doc: the picture's luma gradient: the force that runs the flow along its contours (core-media.edges)

palette.doc: tints the fast streaks and the highlights

cells.doc: velocity grid height in cells (width follows the aspect)

iters.doc: Jacobi pressure iterations per step (rounded to even)

react.doc: how much the bass winds the stirrers (and the edge push) up

along.doc: edge push: 0 across the contours (toward bright), ±1 along them

buoy.doc: bright areas rise, dark ones sink

vort.doc: vorticity confinement: keeps small curls alive

resurface.doc: how fast the live picture seeps back in

reform.doc: how strongly the picture re-forms at the start of each phrase

beat.doc: the picture snaps back a little on each onset

tint.doc: palette colour in the fast streaks

gloss.doc: wet-ink lighting from the dye's own relief
